QUOTE: `platform_calloc_uninit` (`platform.c:25`) is the fallback that always returns NULL. It is selected when `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` is not defined.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the calloc fallback returns NULL but never says the uninitialised free does nothing, and it states the pointers default to the standard functions rather than to failing stubs.
